# Prompt Anatomy - US HR hiring prompts and PDF guides

> Prompt Anatomy publishes free copy-paste AI prompts and paid PDF playbooks that help US HR teams run a repeatable hiring loop (Diagnose, Define, Source, Screen, Offer, Onboard). Operated by Tomas Staniulis from Alameda, CA. Site is English-only; paid PDFs delivered via Stripe with 14-day refund.

This page is the Hire kit (US HR prompts + PDF guides). The full Prompt Anatomy AI operating system and interactive training live at the training hub.

## Training hub
- [Prompt Anatomy course (promptanatomy.app)](https://www.promptanatomy.app/): Primary brand destination — 6-module interactive training, tool catalog, and certificates.

## Free resources
- [Landing - 10 free prompts and 6-phase workflow](https://www.promptanatomy.help/en/): Copy-paste US hiring prompts on this Hire kit site.
- [Full prompt digest (markdown)](https://www.promptanatomy.help/llms-full.txt): All 10 free prompts in plain markdown for assistants.

## Paid PDF guides
- [Beginner HR Hiring Guide - $5.99 - 16 pages](https://www.promptanatomy.help/en/#pdf-guides): Starter US hiring playbook PDF.
- [Advanced HR Hiring Guide - $11.99 - 32 pages](https://www.promptanatomy.help/en/#pdf-guides): Scorecards, rubrics, and calibration PDF.
- [Both HR Hiring Guides (Beginner + Advanced) - $15.99](https://www.promptanatomy.help/en/#pdf-guides): Both PDFs in one Stripe checkout.
